Argentina stages late comeback to defeat Egypt in World Cup match

Argentina secured a dramatic 3-2 victory over Egypt in a Round of 16 FIFA World Cup 2026 match. Trailing 0-2 late in the game, Argentina scored three goals in the final minutes to avoid an early exit and advance to the quarterfinals. The match featured a penalty miss by Messi and a significant comeback.
